name: Reka Core
description: Multimodal model with video understanding and strong reasoning.
longDescription: Reka Core is a frontier multimodal model capable of processing text, images, video, and audio inputs. It stands out for its native video understanding capabilities and competitive performance on language benchmarks, rivaling much larger models from established providers.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.reka.ai/v1/chat",
    headers={"X-Api-Key": "$REKA_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"model": "reka-core", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]}
)
print(response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
